name: 28083 · Kannapolis, NC
findings: ZIP 28083 (Kannapolis) has 77 nonprofit organizations. 30 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28083 (Kannapolis) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 28083 (Kannapolis) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 72% of the typical level).

observations.text: 10 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
